token_file.label: API token file
token_file.description: File holding your Todoist API token (Settings → Integrations → Developer). Keep it chmod 600. The TODOIST_TOKEN environment variable takes precedence.

refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often tasks are fetched. Right-click the widget to refresh immediately.

max_upcoming.label: Upcoming tasks in tooltip
max_upcoming.description: How many upcoming tasks the tooltip lists after the overdue ones.

error.no_token: No API token. Set the token file in the plugin settings.
